costTiers.low: The smallest, fastest model that follows instructions and reads files reliably.
costTiers.standard: A general model that writes and tests code reliably.
costTiers.high: The most capable model available. Use it only when an error is expensive.

explore-report.use: Search files, summarize context, collect command output, and write progress or evidence reports.

implement.use: Plan one feature, change code and tests, and repair verification failures.

review.use: Independently review a normal diff that matches no risky-review trigger.

risky-review.use: Independently review a diff that matches a risky-review trigger.
